name: heph
description: Design real, buildable machines with HEPH-3D and see them in 3D beside the conversation.

interface.longDescription:
HEPH-3D is a free desktop app that turns a description into a machine you can actually build: printable parts, real electronics mounted at their true hole patterns, wiring with wire gauges and connectors, a priced parts list and a QC report, all checked before export.

This connects it to Claude. Ask for a machine and Claude designs it, builds it and fixes what the checks find, while the model turns in 3D beside the conversation. Open it full screen, or in the HEPH-3D app for the full workspace.

Needs HEPH-3D installed on the same computer (free from heph3d.com). Everything runs locally: your designs never leave your computer except as part of your own conversation with Claude.
